$comment: Nissan 350Z / Fairlady Z (Z33), every factory trim found for Japan (goo-net, GAZOO, carview and Car Sensor catalogues plus Nissan Japan releases and Nissan's own back-number catalogue), Europe/UK (Nissan Europe and GB spec sheets and releases, German price lists, ADAC) and the US (Nissan service manuals 2003-2007, press kits, EPA test-car data, magazine spec boxes). Researched 2026-09-27. Values are stored in the units the sources print. JDM weights are JIS 車両重量 (full fuel, no driver); European weights are the no-driver kerb weight; US curb weights are mostly aggregator figures (no Nissan table survives). Japanese catalogue periods with identical numbers are merged into one trim, as are consecutive US model years. Left out: the NISMO Type 380RS (3.8 L NISMO engine, 300 cars), the S-tune GT (NISMO complete car) and the Australian market (Redbook data only, inconsistent weights).

curbWeight.note: US curb weight. Aggregator data (iSeeCars, KBB, autopadre, carspecs), which appear to share one upstream database, so agreement between them is not independent; no Nissan weight table for the Z33 survives online. Magazine test cars weighed about 100 lb more (Car and Driver: 2003 Track 3,322 lb, 2005 35th Anniversary 3,360 lb). Two aggregator data sets disagree for MY2005: autopadre/carspecs give values about 24-26 lb above MY2003-04 (plausible: MY2005 added standard TPMS, heated mirrors and a seat lifter per the MY2005 kit), while iSeeCars/KBB repeat the MY2003-04 figures exactly (likely carried over). Preferred the autopadre/carspecs set, unverified. iSeeCars/KBB: 3,225.

geometry.plan: Mount points (mount_engine, mount_trans, mount_intake, mount_exhaust, mount_radiator, mount_wheel_*, seats, aero) and the engine-bay envelope will be measured in Phase 4 from a to-scale, licensed (CC0/CC-BY/commercial) Z33 3D model, checked against the published wheelbase (2650 mm), tracks (1535/1540 mm; 1536/1540-1546 mm on 2006-on US cars) and overall size (4310 x 1815 x 1315 mm). No coordinates are filled in until then.
